manual_items.name: MATLAB
manual_items.notes: Both official MATLAB R2018a Linux ISO images are staged in .software_cache (DVD1 SHA-256 780717eeeaf11855a119ffe5e3e8be3443df4b1b79a2dcb04feb4c3ea7eb693e; DVD2 485467b9662b7d2f6bbf92b84b18b95fed93a9d6fc6ead4c806b1b67e9296997). The separately downloaded crack archive was deliberately not copied, opened or used. Installation and EasySpin execution require a legitimate MathWorks File Installation Key plus license file/server information.

manual_items.name: OpenEye
manual_items.notes: Explicitly disabled by the operator because it is not needed and no license is available. It is absent from BackendSpecs and the MCP catalog; a conda package alone would not authorize use without a valid OpenEye license.

manual_items.name: Schrödinger
manual_items.notes: The supplied schroedinger-1.0.11-7 Arch package was identified from .PKGINFO as an ANSI C implementation of the Dirac video codec, not the commercial Schrödinger chemistry suite. It is retained only under .software_cache/schrodinger/rejected with SHA-256 41906fcce0eeb74edcaf50ee46635c2f336703692d956782dba7dd1f419187b7 and is not installed or exposed. A genuine Schrödinger Suite installer and site license are still required if this backend is wanted.

manual_items.name: NIST CCCBDB Interface
manual_items.notes: CCCBDB has no public documented REST/JSON API and is suitable only for limited interactive single-molecule webpage use. It remains outside BackendSpecs and is not exposed through MCP; no brittle page scraping or bulk crawler is added.
